# Writing

Ideas take long to hatch before coming to fruition and probably become journal articles. This collection brings together essays, research notes, and commentary on artificial intelligence, communication, journalism, governance, and society. Some pieces expand on published research, while others explore questions as they coagulate in my head in response to exposure to literature.

:::

## Featured Writing

::: {.featured-writing}

### Why Responsible AI Needs the Global South

Artificial intelligence governance, and truthfully, a huge chunk of technological endeavours is often discussed through the lens of Western technological and regulatory centers. This essay argues that many of today's governance frameworks look past the social, political, and technological realities of the Global South, and that these regions should have a rather active role in shaping the future of responsible AI.

*12 min read · Essay*

[Read the Essay →](essays/why-responsible-ai-needs-the-global-south.qmd)

:::

::: {.featured-writing}

### Journalism After Generative AI

What happens when journalists increasingly work integrated with generative AI? This essay explores how automation is reshaping verification, professional identity, editorial judgment, and public trust, drawing on newsroom experiences from the Global South.

*13 min read · Essay*

[Read the Essay →](essays/journalism-after-generative-ai.qmd)

:::

## Why I Write

::: {.writing-purpose} 

Research papers answer specific questions, but writing creates space to ask new ones.

Specifically, these essays and notes allow me to think beyond the rigid walls of academic publishing, reflect on work in progress, and engage broader conversations around artificial intelligence, communication, and society. While some ideas eventually become conference papers or journal articles, others remain exploratory by design.
